teaser: A birthday candle, relit after the wind takes the first flame, waits on a cake made sure to come out right. Life path 6 is the number of the one who holds a house together, and INTJ is the type that would rather build the house correctly than simply hold it. Cross the two and you get someone who treats care as a problem to be solved well, who shows love less through presence than through getting it right the first time, who can name the structural weakness in a family before anyone else sees the crack.
